Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Class ArchiveReader

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.ArchiveReader
All Implemented Interfaces:
GraphReader, AutoCloseable
public class ArchiveReader extends Object implements GraphReader
A story graph reader that reads from a ZIP archive file. Each of the stroy graph's "files" are entries in the archive file.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • ArchiveReader

      public ArchiveReader(File file) throws IOException
      Constructs a new archive graph reader from a given archive file.
      Parameters:
      file - the archive file that stores a story graph
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while opening the file
      NoSuchFileException - if the file does not exist
      ZipException - if the archive file is not formatted correctly
      SecurityException - if the archive file cannot be opened due to the current security manager
